authority.parent_receipt: durable host ledger record of an observed Burn-backed run
authority.payload: exact little-endian f32 bytes from that receipt output
authority.child_input: configured issuer signature over the target state input and its values
authority.handoff_record: host ledger transition; it does not authorize an agent action

valid_transition: runner retrieves parent receipt by receipt_id from the same subject-bound ledger
caller supplies the receipt output_f32_le_base64 as a state input payload
host checks exact shape and f32 digest equality before binding
issuer signature verifies the child state claim for the target program manifest
host atomically commits the child input claim and parent-to-child handoff record
later execution receipt references the handoff record and its child input claim
the same subject/source/logical state port/branch must advance to a strictly newer parent receipt sequence

branching.forking: caller chooses another bounded handoff_branch_id to start an independent state lineage
branching.replay_policy: a receipt cannot rewind or repeat within the same subject/source/logical port/branch

transport.shape: the exact parent output shape; rank 4 with positive u32 dimensions

limits: Only role=state can consume a parent execution receipt.
The child claim must satisfy the target manifest and configured issuer policy.
The host checks value continuity; the original receipt ID is a host ledger reference, not an issuer signature over causal meaning.
Cross-subject handoffs are rejected; direct WASM APIs bypass this Node host transition.
